interventions: No external packages or network requests used. Python3 standard library used only for edit, measurement and acceptance harnesses; delivered app is pure Veritas.
The bare veritas --help invocation was unsupported; used the installed README/reference instead.
setup/build/followup phase durations use UTC start plus filesystem creation/modification timestamps; measurements.json separately records a directly timed final compilation.

Invalid ledger dates/amounts are rejected rows while valid rows contribute. Invalid CLI dates/options preserve an existing report. This resolves the brief wording consistently with its malformed-row requirement.
failures: Installed CLI does not support --help (exit 1); documented command reference supplied the commands.

recommendation.reason: The isolated Veritas implementation passed the required cases. This assignment did not inspect or execute a Python implementation, so it does not establish a comparative preference.
recommendation.observed_user_benefit: Exact arbitrary-precision cents, deterministic JSON, row diagnostics, atomic output and a relocatable Python-free app were delivered with no third-party dependencies.
material_regressions: The packaged app occupies 12881497 bytes, including its runtime.
One measured installed launch took about 0.462 seconds.
Strict calendar validation and flag parsing were implemented manually.
